HOW TO USE

One folder, three possible jobs: cut out the background, add a watermark, crop to story size. Switch on the ones you want today and press Run: only those run. Here A and C are on and B is off.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Products inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Using the switch

  • Click a row on Mute Switch Pixaroma to switch that step on (orange) or off (grey). The muted node greys out on the canvas.
  • Wire the LAST node of a step into a row, here the Preview of each step. Everything before it is skipped along with it, because ComfyUI never runs what nothing needs.
  • Add a step: build it, then wire its last node into the empty row at the bottom; a new empty row appears.

 Mute (the default) skips a step completely. Bypass instead lets the picture pass through the switched-off nodes unchanged.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Which background model Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at a folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through the workflow, one after the other. Its filename output carries each picture's name to the save node, and index says which picture it is (1, 2, 3 ...).
  • Mute Switch Pixaroma (2. switch each step on or off) - One switch per step. A row that is OFF mutes the node wired into it, and everything feeding only that node is skipped too. Multi lets any steps run together; Single runs exactly one. Click a row's label to rename it.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Remove Background Pixaroma (cut out) - Step A: cuts out the subject with the BiRefNet model.
  • Text Watermark Pixaroma (your text) - Step B: stamps your text in the corner of every picture.
  • Resize Crop Pixaroma (story 1080 x 1920) - Step C: crops every picture to the 1080 x 1920 story size.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Preview Image Pixaroma (step A: cut out, saved) - The end of step A: shows the cut-outs and saves them into ComfyUI/output/On Off/No Background. It is wired into row A of the Mute Switch.
  • Preview Image Pixaroma (step B: watermark, saved) - The end of step B, saved into On Off/Watermarked. Wired into row B, which is OFF in the demo.
  • Preview Image Pixaroma (step C: story size, saved) - The end of step C, saved into On Off/Story. Wired into row C.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

Steps onTime
A and C (the demo), 4 picturesabout 3.5 s
All three, 4 picturesabout 4 s

No big model: BiRefNet is 444 MB, the other steps use none.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.
